title: The Signal Earth Sent That Could Destroy Us
hook: In 1974, we beamed a message into space—but we might have just told a predator exactly where we live.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reverses the hopeful narrative of SETI into a terrifying 'we doomed ourselves' twist—high shareability.

title: The Dead Star That's Still Sending Commands
hook: A pulsar died billions of years ago, but its beam is still controlling something—and it's aimed at Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies a hidden purpose behind a natural phenomenon, triggering 'who programmed this?' curiosity.

title: The Asteroid That Has a Binary Code—Inscribed by Nothing
hook: A chunk of space rock carries a sequence of 1s and 0s that could be a message—but there's no known source.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines ancient alien tropes with hard data anomaly—viewers will argue about natural vs artificial origin.

title: The Classified 'Shadow Satellite' That Watches Us for Someone Else

why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy fuel meets genuine orbital mystery—perfect for dark space lore audiences.

why_this_can_go_viral: Short, shocking, and asks a question science can't answer—built for comments and debate.

title: The 'Extinction Star' Hiding in a Constellation We Can See Tonight

title: The Fermi Paradox 'Timer' That Counts Down to Our Silence

why_this_can_go_viral: Creates urgency and a 'we need to act now' narrative—highly shareable in doomer circles.

title: The Galilean Moon That Screams—Literally

why_this_can_go_viral: Anthropomorphizing a moon's natural emission into a 'cry for help' triggers emotional sharing.

title: The Classified 'Gravity Gun' That Almost Split the Moon

why_this_can_go_viral: Sounds like science fiction but presented as declassified truth—perfect for conspiracy documentary fans.

title: The Star That Burns Alcohol—And It's Drifting Toward Us

why_this_can_go_viral: Quirky hook ('alcohol star') lures in casual viewers, then delivers existential threat payload.

title: The Dark Matter 'Lake' Beneath Antarctica That Swallows Physics

title: The Alien Signal That Matched a Prime Number—And Then Changed

title: The Classified 'Neutron Bomb' That Could Crack a Planet in Half

why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a 'dead ocean' carrying alien remains taps into cosmic horror and curiosity about life beyond Earth.

title: The Black Hole That Flashed a Message in Morse Code

why_this_can_go_viral: Morse code implies deliberate transmission—viewers will demand decryption and share wildly.

title: The Extinction That Came From a Black Hole in the Oort Cloud
hook: A small black hole may be hiding in our own solar system—and every 30 million years, it sends death our way.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines 'hidden black hole' with 'mass extinction cycle'—the ultimate cosmic horror premise.
